mapper.select: SELECT m.MATERIAL_CODE, /*物料编号*/ m.MATERIAL_CODE RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE, m.MATERIAL_NAME, /*物料名称*/ g.MIX_AREA, /*密炼区*/ g.BATCH_NO as GLUE_SCHEDULE_BATCH_NO, /*终炼母炼排程批次号*/ g.ORDER_NO as GLUE_SCHEDULE_ORDER_NO, /*终炼母炼排程工单号*/ ifnull(MID_PLAN_QTY,0) + ifnull(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0) + ifnull(DAY_PLAN_QTY, 0) as DEMAND_QTY, /*需求量*/ ifnull(g.MID_PLAN_QTY, 0) as MID_PLAN_QTY, /*中班计划量*/ ifnull(g.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0) as NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, /*夜班计划量*/ ifnull(g.DAY_PLAN_QTY, 0) as DAY_PLAN_QTY, /*白班计划量*/ g.MID_EXPECT_START_TIME as GLUE_MID_EXPECT_START_TIME, /*胶料中班开始预计生产时间*/ ifnull(g.MID_PLAN_QTY, 0) as GLUE_MID_PLAN_QTY, /*胶料中班计划量*/ g.NIGHT_EXPECT_START_TIME as GLUE_NIGHT_EXPECT_START_TIME, /*胶料夜班开始预计生产时间*/ ifnull(g.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0) as GLUE_NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, /*胶料夜班计划量*/ g.DAY_EXPECT_START_TIME as GLUE_DAY_EXPECT_START_TIME, /*胶料白班开始预计生产时间*/ ifnull(g.DAY_PLAN_QTY, 0) as GLUE_DAY_PLAN_QTY /*胶料白班计划量*/ FROM T_GLUE_SCHEDULE_RESULT g INNER JOIN T_MIX_MACHINE e on g.MACHINE_CODE = e.MACHINE_CODE INNER JOIN T_MES_PMT_RECIPE r on g.glue = r.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME and g.MACHINE_CODE = r.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE and g.RECIPE_TYPE=r.RECIPE_TYPE and g.RECIPE_VERSION_ID=r.RECIPE_VERSION_ID /*根据物料名称、机台、配方类型、配方版本号关联*/ INNER JOIN T_MES_PMT_RECIPE_WEIGHT t on r.RECIPE_ID = t.FATHER_RECIPE_ID INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL m on t.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE /*根据物料编码关联*/ WHERE g.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND g.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND g.del_flag = '0' AND r.RECIPE_STATE = '1' /*配方状态: 再用*/ AND r.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' /*审核标志： 已审核*/ AND m.MAJOR_TYPE = '2' /*物料大类为：硫磺辅料*/ /*密炼机如果有硫磺称，则终炼胶不需要硫磺排程计划；密炼机如果有辅料成，则母炼胶不需要辅料排程计划*/ AND ((e.HAVE_SULFUR_STEELYARD = '0' AND instr(glue,'/') = 0) OR (e.HAVE_MATERIAL_STEELYARD = '0' AND instr(glue,'/') > 0))
mapper.sql: SELECT m.MATERIAL_CODE, /*物料编号*/ m.MATERIAL_CODE RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE, m.MATERIAL_NAME, g.ENTRUSTED_MIX_AREA as MIX_AREA, 'MATERIAL_SPAN' as GLUE_SCHEDULE_BATCH_NO, /*表示跨区接收*/ g.id as GLUE_SCHEDULE_ORDER_NO, /*接收记录ID*/ ifnull(TOTAL_RECEIVE_QTY, 0) as DEMAND_QTY, /*需求量*/ ifnull(g.TOTAL_RECEIVE_QTY, 0) as MID_PLAN_QTY, /*中班计划量*/ 0 as NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, /*夜班计划量*/ 0 as DAY_PLAN_QTY, /*白班计划量*/ ifnull(g.TOTAL_RECEIVE_QTY, 0) as GLUE_MID_PLAN_QTY, /*胶料中班计划量*/ 0 as GLUE_NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, /*胶料夜班计划量*/ 0 as GLUE_DAY_PLAN_QTY, /*胶料白班计划量*/ g.MACHINE_CODE, /*机台代号*/ g.RECIPE_TYPE, /*配方类型*/ g.RECIPE_VERSION_ID, /*配方版本号*/ g.RECIPE_STAGE, /*配方阶段*/ '3' DATA_SOURCE /*数据来源：跨区接收*/ FROM T_MATERIAL_SPAN_RECEIVE g INNER JOIN (SELECT max(MATERIAL_CODE) as MATERIAL_CODE, MATERIAL_NAME FROM T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL WHERE MAJOR_TYPE ='2' /*物料大类为：硫磺辅料*/ group by MATERIAL_NAME) m on m.MATERIAL_NAME=g.MATERIAL_NAME WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0'

mapper.select: SELECT ifnull(max(MID_PRODUCE_ORDER), 0) MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, max(MID_EXPECT_FINISH_TIME) MID_EXPECT_FINISH_TIME, ifnull(max(NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER),0) NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, max(NIGHT_EXPECT_FINISH_TIME) NIGHT_EXPECT_FINISH_TIME, ifnull(max(DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER), 0) DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, max(DAY_EXPECT_FINISH_TIME) DAY_EXPECT_FINISH_TIME, machine_code FROM T_MATERIAL_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND machine_code=#{machineCode} GROUP BY machine_code

mapper.select: SELECT M.MATERIAL_CODE MATERIAL_CODE, /*物料编号*/ M.MATERIAL_CODE RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE, M.MATERIAL_NAME, /*物料名称*/ MAX(S.SAFE_STOCK) AS SAFE_STOCK_QTY /*安全库存*/ FROM T_LHFL_SAFE_STOCK S INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(MATERIAL_CODE) MATERIAL_CODE, MATERIAL_NAME FROM T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL M WHERE M.MAJOR_TYPE = '2' /*物料大类为：硫磺辅料*/ AND M.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY MATERIAL_NAME) M ON S.MATERIAL = M.MATERIAL_NAME /*根据物料名称关联*/ WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND S.SAFE_STOCK > 0 GROUP BY M.MATERIAL_NAME, M.MATERIAL_CODE
